title: Monthly Pine+ members churn twice as fast in month 3, and a third order is the best early warning
subtitle: The drop comes once the free-shipping honeymoon ends. Members who place a third order within 60 days mostly stay, so the time to step in is month 2.
summary: Monthly-plan Pine+ members churn at 18.6% in their third month, more than twice the rate of neighbouring months, while annual members show no such cliff. A third order within 60 days of joining is the strongest early signal of retention, so we recommend testing a month-2 order nudge and an annual-conversion offer.
key_findings: Month-3 churn for monthly-plan members is 18.6%, vs. an average of 8.4% in months 1, 2 and 4.
Six months after joining, 55.4% of monthly members are still active vs. 96.8% of annual members.
Members with 3+ orders in their first 60 days churn at 6.1% in month 3 vs. 28.8% for those with one order; a 9.8 pp gap remains after matching.
Black Friday promo joiners churn at 26.8% in month 3, more than twice the organic rate (11.7%).
Cutting the month-3 hazard by 4 pp would save about 3,000 members and about $0.6M in contribution a year.
